(2) the HOST FLAG --editor-extensions in HostOptions (default OFF on every host): refused with --play; refused with a non-loopback --bind unless a --tokens-file is in use (so roles exist; consistent with the fail-closed bind work); allowed with --read-only (listing works; invocation is refused later by the read-only gate); document in --help and docs.
